title: Complete pooled complex admission and conditional κ = 1/580 transfer
body:
The pooled complex fill previously had a better finite moment without a source-specific physical recursive and integer outer construction. This package completes its finite admission, binds all six local programs and the complete global owner/controller schedule to the retained T74 implementation, and derives the conditional bound

`T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1-1/580))`, with `O(n)+F_q` space.

The conservative `κ=1/580 ≈ 0.00172413793103448` exceeds the selected `0.001672660197076918`. It includes all restoration, exact child returns, stopped recursion, support exposure and inverse exposure, three Gaussian transforms, three CRT conversions, scalar products and exact integer recovery. The main result uses the existing retuned B1 backend. The separate optional B2 calculation and stronger legacy arithmetic candidate are not used to advertise this physical bound.

The result is conditional on the explicitly retained native/whole-call hosting, physical primitive/refinement and Gaussian/prime analytic contracts. Finite evidence, written all-parameter proofs and source/constructor checks are labelled separately. There is no production-size end-to-end payload run, formal-kernel theorem, unconditional result or selected-frontier update.

Review `research/complex-pooled-full-admission/README.md`, then `PHYSICAL-GLOBAL.md` and `OUTER-JOIN.md`. `OUTER-DOMAIN.md` and `OUTER-CHECK.md` cover the actual constructor/cohort, normalization, eventual production domain and error/recovery budget. Exact source references and required runtime-source boundaries are retained.

Validation:

- Complete finite release passed: fresh active FOUR native execution, authenticated retained THREE reuse, 160 admission / 34 controller / 12 BIT / 8 owner / 6 geometry controls, and 14 reuse challenges in each Python mode.
- Global binding covers all 3,240 calls, 2,047,680 owner entries, 6,489 helper charts and 162,900 idle children, including paid restoration and common-grid guards.
- Independent exact outer checks cover 12,788 finite bilinear coefficients, 27 recovery cases and 13 rejection controls. These are not production physical execution.
- All eight registered normal/optimized commands passed from the committed Git-free export (285 payload files; all 286 files including the export manifest unchanged). Committed-byte and source-history preflights passed. Publication commit: `a929a3fa36301bdfcffe82afd37434dd9e3c4887`.

Credit: Rohan Arun owns the pooled fill (PR4181); yssite the preceding complete admission (PR4180); Cinna Davis and David Ganz the native/operator/owner lineage. Jose Manuel owns the retained physical T74, retuned ordinary, support/Fourier/chirp and Gaussian constructions; Tekalign owns the CRT converter. Original analytic sources and notices are retained. This contribution supplies their source-specific integration and complete conservative comparison; it does not claim to originate all the gain over the selected record.

Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation and separate specialist review. These reviews are part of the author process, not independent human certification. No shared source or frozen predecessor was edited.
